label: DX-Compass
info:
# DX-Compass

Multi-callsign DX Spot monitor with DVR-style map grid.

Data sources (no DX cluster telnet required):
- PSKReporter MQTT v2 live feed (mqtt.pskreporter.info:1883, the GridTracker2 source) - CW/DIGI spots with real mode and SNR; subscriptions auto-follow the monitored calls.
- dxwatch.com public spot feed (polled every 30s over HTTPS) - FT8/SSB/DIGI etc.
- reversebeacon.net RBN feed (polled every 10s over HTTPS) - CW with SNR in dB.
Every spot already carries spotter/DX coordinates (Maidenhead grids or the ci / call_info object),
so distance is computed without any external geolocation lookup.

Spots matching a monitored callsign are recorded to SQLite and broadcast
to the frontend over WebSocket. Duplicates arriving from all three sources
are dropped via a shared in-memory dedup cache. Adding a new callsign
triggers a one-shot dxwatch historical backfill (up to 7 days / 150 spots)
and a new PSKReporter MQTT subscription.

Spots older than 1 hour are persisted to the database but are not sent
to the map.

Frontend is served from the ./public folder (httpStatic).

name: dxwatch.com + reversebeacon.net feeds (HTTPS polling, no telnet)
info:
dxwatch (30s poll):
1. GET dxwatch.com/dxsd1/s.php?s=<lastId>&r=200&d=1
2. Covers FT8/SSB/DIGI/CW; new calls trigger cdx=<call> history backfill.

RBN (10s poll):
1. On startup fetch reversebeacon.net/main.php and extract RBN_version_hash.
2. GET reversebeacon.net/spots.php?h=<hash>&ma=36000&s=<lastId>&r=200
3. CW skimmer spots with real SNR in dB. 400 response = stale hash -> refetch.

Both chains: filter by monitored calls, compute distance from home
(haversine), cross-source dedup, record to SQLite (dedup by spot_id;
RBN ids are stored negative) and broadcast to the frontend.

msg.topic = `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    spot_id INTEGER UNIQUE,
    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
    monitored_call TEXT NOT NULL,
    de TEXT NOT NULL,
    freq REAL,
    spot_call TEXT NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT,
    spot_time TEXT,
    mode TEXT,
    signal TEXT,
    snr REAL,
    lat REAL,
    lon REAL,
    distance_km REAL,
    distance_miles REAL,
    band TEXT,
    dx_lat REAL,
    dx_lon REAL
);`;
return msg;
